google_review_notes: No login required. Breathing Exercise opens on the Breathe tab after a 3-card intro (Skip). Pick a session length (1, 2, 3 or 5 minutes are free) and tap Begin: a circle grows while you breathe in, holds, and shrinks while you breathe out, with optional soft tones, voice cues and haptic ticks (Settings). Patterns tab lists Box 4-4-4-4, 4-7-8, Coherent 5.5, Physiological sigh 2-1-6 and Calm 4-6; custom patterns, sessions of 10-30 minutes and the full history are Pro. Progress shows streak, minutes and a calendar. The optional daily reminder is in Settings and asks for notification permission only when switched on. Pro and Remove Ads are one-time in-app products (Settings > Purchases); Restore purchases is in the same section. All data stays on the device. HEALTH APPS DECLARATION: wellness breathing timer only, not a medical device; no diagnosis, treatment or medical/anxiety claims; wording is 'may help you relax' and 'not medical advice'.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test in-app purchases open Settings (gear, top right) > Purchases: Go Pro (pro_lifetime) or Remove ads (remove_ads); Restore purchases is in the same section. The app is a relaxation breathing timer, not a medical device; all data stays on device. No demo account needed.
